scope: Local availability and workflow diagnostics with synthetic services; no production mutations or authentication bypass tests.

checks.name: teacher-timeout-lock-survives-reentry
checks.detail: A transport timeout locks creation; re-entering the page remains locked. Source inventory finds no directory-based confirmation/clear route. The pending key is not scoped by HQ UID.

checks.name: purchase-timeout-not-found-unlocks
checks.detail: A first not-found recovery clears an uncertain lock; a second click sends a new request ID. This does not simulate real database writes or claim confirmed duplicate orders.

checks.name: purchase-recovered-form-still-ready
checks.detail: Recovery of a complete prior order leaves its original purchase quantity in place and the form ready to submit again.

checks.name: customer-timeout-loses-request-on-reentry
checks.detail: After a timeout, re-entering with the same synthetic form produces a different request ID because it was kept only in page memory. No photos or real face APIs were used.

checks.name: camera-reset-during-customer-submit
checks.detail: The enabled camera reset event clears the in-memory request ID while photo validation is pending; the later register request receives an empty ID.
